purpose.summary: This is a hospital admission/discharge registration component (入退院登録, I01) of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (billing) software system. It handles patient admission and discharge recording, insurance combination checks, ward/room fee calculations, and related medical administration workflows for Japanese healthcare facilities.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance)

Handles Japanese insurance system specifics: elderly patient flags, specific admission fee codes, disaster/emergency admissions
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, resulting in mojibake in comment lines. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. The COPY count shown as 0 in mechanical indicators appears inconsistent with the visible COPY statements in the source snippet — likely the mechanical parser missed them. The program is a large, mature production component with a long documented change history.
